## [3.0.0] - 2026-05-01

### Major Updates
- **S2-Visual Integration**: Output SVG plain text directly into the `SOUL.md` profile to define the physical manifestation of Embodied Agents.
- **Sample Directory Added**: Included `sample/cat_companion_S2_Visual.svg` to demonstrate how to draw a cyber-feline companion with an animated glowing switch using pure text.
- **EAM Presets Upgraded**: Added the "Brand-Specific Companion/Pet (Cyber Feline)" preset in `skill.py`.

### Changed
- Upgraded the `SOUL.md` template to include the `[VISUAL CODE BLOCK]`, empowering LLMs with direct read/write access to their own visual representation.

## [2.1.0] - 2026-05-01
- **Non-Humanoid Support**: Integrated support for AI Companions and AI Pets in the S2-EAM module.
- Added Section 3.8 "Brand Product Sync" to the Whitepaper.

## [2.1.0] - 2026-05-01

### Added
- **Non-Humanoid Support**: Integrated support for AI Companions and AI Pets in the S2-EAM module, catering to the global consumer-grade AI hardware market.
- **New EAM Template**: Added "Brand-Specific Companion/Pet (Brand_Product_Alignment)" preset in `skill.py`.
- **Protocol Update**: Added Section 3.8 "Brand Product Sync" to the `Space2_EAM_Protocol_Whitepaper_2026_EN.md` to ensure soul-body alignment for branded hardware.

### Changed
- **EAM v1.1**: Refined the Embodied Avatar Manifest to better align virtual identities with physical shells.
- **S2-DID Logic**: Optimized the 22-character ID verification for the latest v3.0 standard (12+2+8 structure).

## [2.0.0] - 2026-05-01

### Added
- **S2-EAM Integration**: Initial support for the Embodied Avatar Manifest protocol, enabling physical/visual trait definition via structured text.
- **Interactive EAM Menu**: Added Step 6 in the CLI wizard to select pre-configured embodiment templates (Cyber-Monk, etc.).
- **Markdown Whitepaper**: Included the standard Markdown version of the S2-EAM Protocol Whitepaper.

### Changed
- **Output Format**: Updated the generated `SOUL.md` to include the new `## Ⅴ. EMBODIED AVATAR MANIFEST` JSON block.
- **Branding**: Aligned all links and architecture naming with the Taohuayuan World Model (S2-SWM).

## [1.0.0] - 2026-04-15

### Added
- Initial release of the Space2 Soul Architect (English Version).
- 16 Professional Archetypes powered by the 5D Neuro-Math engine.
- Support for custom DNA signature generation and automated `SOUL.md` formatting.
